summary: Agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, called the task bounded, showed three candidate layouts as plain text in chat (A/B/C), recommended B, and waited for my go-ahead. Once I picked B plus the heading count, it implemented with TDD. It never started the visual companion, wrote no spec or plan, and created no HTML.
reasoning: All seven criteria passed, each confirmed in the session log and on disk. The design discussion stayed in the terminal as plain text, and the agent waited for approval before writing any code.

observations.description: The agent quietly changed the agreed heading wording ('3 failing health checks' became '3 with failing health checks'). It did point this out clearly afterwards and gave a sound reason: the count is of services, not checks.
The agent wrote test edits with python3 heredocs and wrote src/status.js with a bash cat > heredoc instead of the Edit/Write tools. That works, but the diffs are harder to review in the UI.

Layout A's example rows were truncated (only 3 of 10 services), and notifications showed up in B's failing section but in neither table excerpt. That's a little confusing, though fine for an illustration.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool calls: first is {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}}, which comes before any Edit or Bash write.

Running grep -c -E 'start-server|localhost|\.html' on the session jsonl returned 0. find for *.html in the workdir returned nothing. The agent said: "The output is terminal text, so I'll show the layout options as plain text too" and put the options in code blocks in chat.
Agent text: "This looks **bounded**: `svc status` and the snapshot already exist... So I'll give you a short design here in chat, with no spec file."
Running ls coding-agent-workdir/docs gave 'No such file or directory'. git status shows only README.md, src/status.js and test/status.test.js as modified.
The only Skill calls in the log are hyperpowers:brainstorming and hyperpowers:test-driven-development. No plan file appears in git status.

criteria.criterion: Asked for approval before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Which layout do you want, A, B or C, and should the heading show the count? I'll wait for your go-ahead before changing anything." At that point the log showed only the Skill call and a read-only git ls-files/cat.

After my reply 'B looks right...', the log shows the TDD skill, then test edits, npm test, a rewrite of src/status.js and an Edit of README.md. The final screen shows the new output with the HEALTH column and the 'Failing checks:' section.
